confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Punta Cana and Dominican Republic price levels; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable, while hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because resort-area rates vary widely by season and property. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (about 3x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. FX: the 0.6955 figure comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange rates overview page. I could not open the RBA page or its F11.1 daily table to confirm the value, so verify it against the official RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Caribbean resort-tourism destinations with similar all-inclusive and tourist-district price structures, adjusted for Dominican Republic domestic price levels in local restaurants and guesthouses. No single named comparable city was used.
